title: "always keep wifi on during sleep" message keeps showing, but therer's no option for this on Android 13
body:
Hey, was there ever a solution for this? It's happening to me. xDrip+ version 344deb4-2022.11.16 ### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/2485
Originally posted by **master3395** November 20, 2022 Hello, i have noticed that with the latest Android 13 You will get annoying messages about enabling "always keep wifi on during sleep". But this option was removed after Android 12. (Not just Samsung like pointed out on the site below, I use OnePlus) https://eu.community.samsung.com/t5/galaxy-s21-series/wifi-keep-on-during-sleep-setting-missing-after-latest-update/td-p/5152555 This warning comes from time to time. I have given xDrip+ all perms that it asks for and more. ``` xDrip+ Version: 344deb4-2022.11.16 Code: 202211618 ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4199669/202935185-98aa46e8-7b30-4e6c-b290-4afd5f59780d.png)

comments.body: You must have seen a request, in English, not to open an issue and open a discussion instead.
